items.claim_text: It looked like a very large fee would appear every time a ship passed through the strait.
The fee was not actually being collected yet.
So the price reacted once, then returned to a high level.
Trump’s proposed Hormuz fee vanished overnight, but crude oil prices stayed high as tensions and tanker fears remained.
So the price reacted once, then returned to a high level.
A story about charging ships suddenly changed into a story about trade and investment.

C2.reason: Ledgerでは制度設計が示されず、徴収は提案段階だったと確認されています。

C5.reason: 一時的な上げ幅縮小後に高水準へ戻った動きは確認できますが、「So」はその動きの原因まで結び付けています。
